componentSources.MenuToggle:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "example/menu-toggle", name: "MenuToggle", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "A menu trigger with parent-owned actions.",
  options: [
    BoolOption(name: "open", default: false),
    ActionOption(name: "onToggle"),
    ActionOption(name: "onSelect"),
  ],
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Row(gap: Space.sm, children: [
      Button(label: options.open ? "Close menu" : "Open menu", onTap: options.onToggle),
      Button(label: "Choose profile", onTap: RunAction(action: options.onSelect, value: "profile")),
    ])
  )],
)
componentSources.MenuHeader:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "example/menu-header", name: "MenuHeader", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "Forward values and callbacks to the trigger.",
  options: [
    BoolOption(name: "open", default: false),
    ActionOption(name: "onToggle"),
    ActionOption(name: "onSelect"),
  ],
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    MenuToggle(open: options.open, onToggle: options.onToggle, onSelect: options.onSelect)
  )],
)
componentSources.VariantCard:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "example/variant-card", name: "VariantCard", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "A card with compact and detailed layouts.",
  defaultVariant: Responsive(base: "compact", lg: "detailed"),
  options: [
    StringOption(name: "title", maxLength: 100, default: "Card"),
    ActionOption(name: "onChoose"),
  ],
  variants: [
    Variant(id: "compact", label: "Compact", options: [
      StringOption(name: "note", maxLength: 100, default: "Compact note"),
    ], build: Column(gap: Space.sm, children: [
      Text(child: "Compact: ${options.title}"),
      Text(child: options.note),
      Button(label: "Choose compact", onTap: options.onChoose),
    ])),
    Variant(id: "detailed", label: "Detailed", options: [
      StringOption(name: "note", maxLength: 100, default: "Detailed note"),
    ], build: Column(gap: Space.sm, children: [
      Text(child: "Detailed: ${options.title}"),
      Text(child: options.note),
      Button(label: "Choose detailed", onTap: options.onChoose),
    ])),
  ],
)

pages.source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "example/variant-page", name: "VariantPage", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "Choose page and component layouts independently.",
  defaultVariant: "standard",
  states: [StringState(name: "selected", default: "none")],
  variants: [
    Variant(id: "standard", label: "Standard", build: Column(gap: Space.md, children: [
      Text(child: "Standard page"),
      Text(child: "Selected: ${state.selected}"),
      VariantCard(title: "First"),
      VariantCard(variant: "detailed", title: "Second", onChoose: SetState(state: "selected", value: "second")),
      VariantCard(variant: isMobile() ? "compact" : "detailed", title: "Conditional"),
    ])),
    Variant(id: "alternate", label: "Alternate", build: Column(gap: Space.md, children: [
      Text(child: "Alternate page"),
      VariantCard(title: "Alternate"),
    ])),
  ],
)

pages.name: Search
pages.source:
Component(
        dsl: 1, id: "example/search", name: "Search", kind: Kind.section, description: "Callback field",
        states: [StringState(name: "query", default: "")],
        variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build: Scaffold(body:
          Column(children: [
            SearchInput(onSearch: SetState(state: "query", value: input.value)),
            Text(child: "Query: ${state.query}"),

            Button(label: "Reset", onTap: SetState(state: "query", value: "")),
          ])
        ))],
      )

pages.name: Motion
pages.source:
Component(
        dsl: 1, id: "example/motion", name: "Motion", kind: Kind.section, description: "Entrance animations",
        variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build: Column(gap: Space.sm, children: [
          Animate(child: Text(child: "Fades in")),
          Animate(effect: Effect.slideUp, duration: 300, delay: 120, curve: Curve.easeOut, distance: 32, child: Text(child: "Slides up")),
          Animate(effect: Effect.slideDown, curve: Curve.linear, child: Text(child: "Slides down")),
          Animate(effect: Effect.slideLeft, curve: Curve.ease, child: Text(child: "Slides left")),
          Animate(effect: Effect.slideRight, curve: Curve.easeIn, child: Text(child: "Slides right")),
          Animate(effect: Effect.scale, curve: Curve.easeInOut, child: Text(child: "Scales")),
          Animate(effect: Effect.pop, curve: Curve.easeOutBack, child: Box(padding: Space.md, background: Color.primary, radius: Radius.md, child: Text(child: "Pops"))),
          ForEach(items: [1, 2, 3], as: "n", indexAs: "i", child: Animate(effect: Effect.slideUp, delay: i * 60, child: Text(child: "Item ${n}"))),
        ]))],
      )

pages.name: Layout
pages.source:
Component(
        dsl: 1, id: "example/layout", name: "Layout", kind: Kind.section, description: "Layout and scope",
        states: [StringState(name: "chosen", default: "none")],
        options: [ColorOption(name: "accent", default: "#123456", allowCustom: true)],
        parts: [Part(name: "heading", build: Text(child: "Layout", role: TextRole.heading))],
        variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build: Scaffold(body: ScrollView(child:
          Column(gap: Space.sm, padding: Insets(x: Space.md, top: Space.sm), children: [
            Use(part: "heading"),
            Box(background: options.accent, border: Border(width: 1, color: Color.border), radius: Radius.md,
              padding: Space.sm, child: Text(child: "Styled", size: FontSize.lg, weight: FontWeight.semibold, color: Color.primaryInk)),
            Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.max, children: [Expanded(child: Text(child: "Expanded")),
              Flexible(fit: FlexFit.loose, child: Text(child: "Flexible")), Spacer(flex: 1)]),
            Wrap(spacing: Space.sm, runSpacing: Space.xs, alignment: WrapAlignment.start,
              children: [Text(child: "Wrap one"), Text(child: "Wrap two")]),
            SizedBox(height: 80, child: Stack(alignment: Anchor.center, children: [
              Box(height: 80, background: Color.surface),
              Positioned(top: 4, left: 4, child: If(condition: true, then: Text(child: "Overlay"))),
            ])),
            Flex(direction: Axis.vertical, children: [Text(child: "Flex")]),
            Divider(thickness: 1, color: Color.border),
            Icon(name: MaterialIcons.check, size: Size.sm),
            Text(child: "Literal $value"),
            ForEach(items: items, as: "item", indexAs: "position", child:
              Button(label: item.label, onTap: SetState(state: "chosen", value: item.label)),
              empty: Text(child: "No choices")),
            Text(child: "Chosen: ${state.chosen}"),
            If(condition: isMobile(), then: Text(child: "Mobile only")),
          ])
        )))],
      )
